Name: (CP x AT x JA) Moon Lamps
Author: Sodacchi
Description:
[color=#666666][b][size=1]MY FIRST MOD[/size][/b][/color][color=#666666][b][size=1]! :D[/size][/b][/color]
[u]                                                                               [/u]
[size=5][b]1.6+[/b][/size][u]

[/u][size=3]Content Patcher now allows to add new items directly without Json Assets.

[size=4][u][b][[color=#6d9eeb]CP[/color]] VERSION[/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3][b]
WHERE TO BUY THE LAMPS:[/b]
﻿You need to buy the recipes from Robin to craft them. [/size][size=3]
[b]
DETAILS:[/b]
﻿Now has all 8 versions!
﻿ ﻿[u]4 brown[/u] versions & [u]4 white[/u] versions.

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#6d9eeb]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/size][size=2][i]
﻿﻿﻿- ﻿(Delete old versions if you are updating them.[/i])[/size][size=3][color=#ff7700]
[/color] - Download the [CP] 1.6 version and extract it to your [i]/Mods[/i] folder.
﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][/spoiler]

[size=4][u][b][[color=#e06666]AT[/color]] VERSION[/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][size=3][b]
WHERE TO BUY THE LAMPS:[/b]
﻿You need to buy one of the AT tools from Robin. [/size][size=3]
[b]
DETAILS:[/b]
Has "Celestial" keyword search for celestial versions.[size=3]

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#e06666]Install SMAPI and Alternative Textures.[/color][/size][size=2][i]
﻿﻿﻿- ﻿(Delete old versions if you are updating them.[/i])[/size][size=3][color=#ff7700]
[/color] - Download the [AT] version and extract it to your [i]/Mods[/i] folder.
﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][/spoiler]

[u][u]                                                                               [/u][/u]
[size=5][b]1.5+[/b][/size] [b]
[size=4][u][[color=#f6b26b]JA[/color]] VERSION[/u][/size]
[/b][spoiler][size=3][b]
WHERE TO BUY THE LAMPS:[/b]
﻿You need to buy the recipes from Robin to craft them. [/size][size=2](Price can be changed in each [i]big-craftable.json[/i])[/size][size=3]
[b]
CONTENT:[/b]
[u]MAIN[/u] - ﻿It has a [i]/brown version[/i] folder where you can replace the look of the polls to brown. [/size][size=2](Backup the originals!)[/size][size=3]
﻿﻿﻿﻿[u]OPTIONAL[/u] - It has both versions, no need to replace them [/size][size=2](unless you want to recolor them)[/size][size=3]

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#f6b26b]Install SMAPI and JSON Assets.[/color][/size][size=2][i]
﻿﻿﻿- ﻿(Delete old versions if you are updating them.[/i])[/size][size=3][color=#ff7700]
[/color] - Download [u]only one[/u] version and extract it to your [i]/Mods[/i] folder.
﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][/spoiler]

[b][size=4][u][[color=#6d9eeb]CP[/color]] VERSION[/u][/size][/b]
[spoiler][size=3][b]
DETAILS:[/b]
[/size][size=3]This version will replace the vanilla lamp-posts.
﻿ ﻿[u]FULL MOON[/u] - Will replace the Wood Lamp-Post.
﻿ ﻿[u]CRESCENT MOON[/u] - Will replace the Iron Lamp-Post.

﻿The [i]config.json [/i]file has the option to allow Celestial versions if changed to [i]True[/i]
﻿[/size][size=2](Either manually from the file or using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod)[/size][size=3]

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿ [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#6d9eeb]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/size][size=2][i]
﻿﻿﻿- ﻿(Delete old versions if you are updating them.[/i])[/size][size=3][color=#ff7700]
[/color] - Download the [CP] version and extract it to your [i]/Mods[/i] folder.
﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][/spoiler]
[size=4][i] ﻿﻿If you have any issues let me know![/i][/size]
